title: Rare Drop Hunter: Sword
text: “Indeed, if the attack power is equal, this leaves no openings at all.”
“Wouldn’t it be even more insane if you dual-wielded it?”
“You can only hold one, so dual-wielding’s not possible.”
“Well then, Motoyasu-kun, want to character change?”
“Leave it to me, I say!”

I character-changed with Ren with a whoosh. I returned to my original spot, and Ren appeared to pop up where I’d been standing, I say. By coincidence, it seemed Ren ended up right where Circle was. Father was busy cooking. Meanwhile, on screen, Ren was protesting sword in hand, indeed.
“Hey! Why’d you suddenly make me character change!”
“Let’s hunt those monsters from earlier until the second one drops. That alone will birth the ultimate broken Sword Hero, one nobody can even get close to.”
“But! You can’t call this ‘the strongest’!”

When Ren swung wildly on screen, three blades of light burst forth in a staggered sequence, indeed. If all of those were generating separate slashing attacks, then you’d have to accept taking damage just to land a hit, I say. And what’s more, if the weapons clashed against each other, they’d simply get deflected. With a spear, you needed precise point-attacks to actually deal damage. I figured Brionac could probably reduce things to cinders, but since this loop’s Ren had thoroughly reinforced the weapon, it might well get deflected regardless.
“Just try it out and see.”
“Grh…”

And so Ren wandered back and forth through the spot where Wyvern Ghosts spawned, swinging the sword more or less at random, indeed. The approaching monsters were simply shredded to pieces and defeated by that alone.
Oh? This isn’t as bad as I thought, is it? Ren’s face began to say something like that, indeed.
“It really is impressive that just swinging carelessly produces that many slashes.”
“If you showed that off during practice with Éclair-san, she’d probably be impressed.”
“Wouldn’t she call it cheating instead? Her swordsmanship is certainly fast, but she doesn’t use anything as bizarre as what Ren-san’s doing right now.”
Multiple slashes appeared at once, after all. And what’s more, the slashes didn’t even collide with each other—they just shredded the enemy clean through.
“This has nothing to do with swordsmanship anymore!”
“That’s just how busted weapons are, isn’t it? Ren’s always been bad against floating-type enemies, so this might actually suit him better.”
“There might even be an upgraded version that does an all-around attack with a single swing.”
“Still, better to keep hold of the second one too. Even equipping it on a floating weapon and just flinging it around carelessly would probably be amazing.”
And so Father and Itsuki stood watching as Ren fought on, waiting for the second one to drop.
“That’s quite the powerful weapon, nano. Could that sword be reproduced, nano?”
“Who knows? But it does seem like there’s a real chance of getting good gear here. Itsuki might get something where his arrows turn into a three-way shot too.”
“That’s practically guaranteed, isn’t it? Firing three arrows at once on a normal attack would definitely be powerful.”
“If it homed in too, like a machine gun, that’d be even more troublesome.”

“So… the power itself isn’t necessarily the strongest, and there’s no bizarre effect like ‘cannot be healed’ or anything, but depending on how you use it, you could end up with a weapon that surpasses Ludgamoira? This world really does run deep.”
“Itsuki! Motoyasu! I’ll remember this!”

Ren spat out something like a curse, indeed. What could possibly bother him so much? For the record, Ren kept hunting there for about two hours until the second one dropped. As for the hunting itself… he boasted with a smug look that steadily grinding away was his specialty. Meanwhile, I enjoyed the seafood pasta Father had so kindly made.

I had a mock battle against Ren while he wielded that sword dual-wielded, and it turned into an eight-hit combo of slashes that let me get nowhere near him, indeed. Left with no choice, I tried weaving my attacks through the gaps using Chaos Stab and Gungnir, but he read it and dodged, indeed. I could certainly understand why Father calls him powerful. That said, Ren declared he intended to deliberately seal away that combination when challenging the dungeon. Apparently, relying on it would cause his technique to dull—some kind of personal principle of his, indeed.
So then, when it became my turn and I advanced, I came across an object closely resembling a Dragon Hourglass. Further down the path stood a door with four crests hung together upon it, indeed.
“That’s blatantly a save point, huh.”

When I approached, something resembling the Dragon Hourglass flashed, indeed. Touching it brought up a map. I could select the cursor at the entrance. Confirm, I say! And with a flash, I was whisked right back to Father and the others, indeed.
“Oh, Motoyasu-san.”
“A portal’s set up too, huh… That’s pretty blatantly ‘right before the boss’ vibes.”
“Without a doubt, there’s a boss there.”
“Motoyasu-sama! Welcome back, indeed!”
Yuki-chan greeted me energetically.
“So who’s going? Well, I get that Motoyasu-kun would volunteer, but maybe we should run some other experiments too?”
“Experiments, you say?”
“Yeah. Like whether we can character change during a boss fight, or whether weapon changes are possible.”
“Thanks to Ren’s hard work, I think our level is plenty sufficient.” Father proposed the testing plan, indeed.
“Indeed, that’s an important point. Leveling up alone might not be enough if it comes down to pure physical attacks, so let’s test it during the boss fight.”
“Understood, I say! I’ll head into the boss room, check whether weapon-changing is possible, then character change, indeed.”
“Itsuki, you switch.”
“Let’s have Ren-san do it here.”
“Don’t hold back. I’m worn out from leveling, so Itsuki should do it.”
Ren and Itsuki kept deferring to each other with “after you, after you,” indeed.
“Itsuki-kun. You really don’t want to do it, huh.”
“Itsuki-sama, this must be rough for you…”
Rafuemon and Riska stood by, watching Itsuki go through that exchange, indeed.
“Grrr…”
Sakura-chan was bored, so she was taking a nap, indeed. Father was currently being held by that very Sakura-chan.
“I’m fundamentally incapable of fighting, so I’m out of the running, huh… fundamentally.”
“Right tool for the right job, nano. Where do you think you’d shine, Naofumi, nano?”
“Well, needless to say, a stage with water. Other than that, maybe a spike zone? I remember progressing by breaking through spikes.”
“Looking forward to it, nano.”
“Shall Father go, then?”

There had been all sorts of places up to now that fell outside my game knowledge, but this one was especially strange among them, indeed. Somehow I was starting to get excited. Playing the game together with Father, indeed.

“I’m just the one who endures, so… Both Ren and Itsuki understand that, which is why they don’t drag me into it. There’s also the option of equipping a counter-type shield and chipping away bit by bit, but that’d take forever. So I’ll pass on this one. I’ll step up if there’s some gimmick that specifically requires someone like me to tank it.”
Indeed, in places where you could just power through with brute force, there was no need for Father to step to the front.
“Let’s settle this by majority vote! Everyone! Who shall be the one to character change!”
“That’s dirty, Itsuki! There’s no way votes will gather in my favor!”
Here, Itsuki proposed a majority vote against Ren, who had no partner to back him up, and Ren protested, indeed.
“Then you should hurry and bring Kurotaro-san along. Or would even that not be enough?”
“Grh… Rafumi’s covering for me back in the village, and Wyndia’s about the only other option I could call! At this point, even calling Luna, prepared for her to self-destruct…”
“You really don’t want to go that far?”
At Father’s question, Ren crossed his arms, thought it over, and then turned to face us all.
“Not that far, but I hate the idea of losing here.”
…It seemed Ren was throwing a tantrum over an intensely trivial point of pride, indeed.
“In the first place, you should all just switch to Motoyasu-sama right away!”
When Yuki-chan raised her voice in protest here, both Ren and Itsuki nodded as if convinced, indeed.
“That’s true. That should settle it. Since there doesn’t seem to be a cooldown on character changes, there’s no problem testing it with Motoyasu-san and switching back right away.”
“Right. So, Motoyasu! Off you go!”

Why is Ren giving me orders! The only ones allowed to command me are Father and Filo-tan, indeed! Just as I thought that, Father waved cheerfully and told me to go on ahead. He was currently being held by nap-time Sakura-chan, which was quite the feast for the eyes, indeed.
“Very well, this Motoyasu! Off I go, I say! First, character change to Itsuki, indeed.”
“Then I’ll character change to Ren-san.”
“And I’ll character change to Motoyasu.”
With that, the discussion concluded, and I set out once more.
